domestic_evidence: Screener.in (https://www.screener.in/company/SHRIPISTON/consolidated/) shows the company as a listed operating manufacturer: "BSE: 544344 NSE: SHRIPISTON" and "About Shriram Pistons & Rings Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of pistons, piston pins, piston rings and engine valves for various automotive companies in the domestic and export markets." Audited standalone revenue is reported quarterly and continuously: "Sales + 750 708 781 761 794 770 855 836 873 865 953 942 1,026" (Rs crore, Sep 2023 to Sep 2026), with FY Mar 2026 standalone sales of 3,527 Rs crore and consolidated 4,459 Rs crore. This is audited GST-inclusive turnover of a going concern, i.e. real domestic supply activity, not a catalogue claim.
note: Legal entity exists and is active: listed on BSE (544344) and NSE (SHRIPISTON), market cap Rs 19,483 Cr, 14 manufacturing plants (Mar 2026), now renamed SPR Auto Technologies Ltd. No liquidation/insolvency indication found, so no rejection ground. HS 840991 (parts for spark-ignition engines) is consistent with the declared product line (pistons, piston rings, pins, engine valves) — no correction needed. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the export leg is unverified. All four permitted trade-data sources were inaccessible (paywall shell or 403) and the search tool failed, so I could not read a single B/L line with date, destination and HS code. The company's own site (shrirampistons.com) failed with SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, so the annual-report export/domestic revenue split could not be retrieved either. Export status is therefore 'unknown', NOT 'confirmed' — the phrase 'domestic and export markets' in the Screener description is a company self-description and does not count as shipment fact under Rule 5. Revenue: FY2026 standalone Rs 3,527 Cr / consolidated Rs 4,459 Cr (Screener, audited). Export volume: null — not public in the sources reachable. Recommend a paid trade-data pull or a retry of the annual report to close the export leg.
